title: Best WordPress Alternatives: No Plugins, No Patching
summary: Six WordPress alternatives compared on real cost, security load and export rights — for agencies, designers and owners who inherited a site.
body_markdown: Blink, Webflow, Wix and Shopify all give you editable robots.txt, sitemap control, redirects and structured data. Squarespace is the weakest — no robots.txt editing, no sitemap control, no page exclusion or priority, and limited canonical and schema control. Framer auto-generates robots.txt and sitemap.xml but makes robots.txt editable only on Pro and above, with redirects also Pro-gated. Blink adds an SEO & AI Search panel that scans the live site, scores it 0–100 across five levers and applies fixes in one click, plus guidance for publishing an` /llms.txt` for AI search engines.
